To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a service-oriented view on the Grid enables the integration of database management technology into Grid applications and services, and (2) the service-oriented view on data management enables the construction of a distributed query processor that factors out the functionalities related to query plan construction and execution as services, which can be dynamically accessed by the application or service that needs to perform a query.
the Grid can be viewed as a service-based platform that enables the construction and execution of distributed query plans, and that this can be accomplished in a declarative manner.

the service-based approach to distributed query processing in the Grid is feasible, that the service-based distributed query processing system that we have built has a number of useful properties, and that the system can be used in a number of interesting ways to support Grid-based data management applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a service-based Grid query engine, which is a key component of an emerging service-oriented Grid architecture.
the question of how to exploit service-based computing to improve data management in a service-oriented Grid environment.
how to integrate database technology with the emerging service-based Grid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed service-based approach to distributed query processing on the Grid provides a powerful, flexible and extensible framework for supporting distributed query processing in Grid environments, and for integrating data management with service-oriented Grid computing.

the system described in the paper represents a significant advance over previous efforts in the area of service-based distributed query processing, in that it provides a complete, fully functional, and practical implementation of a service-oriented query processor for the data-intensive Grid.
service-oriented Grids are a very promising approach for distributed query processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
service-based Grids can benefit from a query processor that is itself service-based.
the proposed approach to service-based distributed querying on the Grid provides a flexible and scalable solution for the integration of query processing with service-oriented architectures.
we have developed a novel approach for integrating data and service management on the Grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the service-based approach to distributed data management is not only viable but also offers significant advantages in terms of flexibility, adaptability, and performance.
a service-based approach to Grid computing can provide a flexible and extensible environment for integrating data management and query processing technology in a service-based computing environment.
a service-based approach to distributed query processing is both feasible and effective, and provides a promising direction for future work in this area.
